definitions.explanation: Slang term for a person with an introverted or reserved personality, often someone who prefers solitary activities or has difficulty socializing. Abbreviation of {陰気|いんき}なキャラクター (gloomy character).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陰|いん}キャ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think I'm totally an introvert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰|いん}キャ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なかった→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: I was an introvert in high school and had few friends.

examples.japanese: {陰|いん}キャ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many hobbies that introverts can enjoy.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Abbreviation of ⟦{陰気|いんき}→陰気：08674_inki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧ (⟦{陰気|いんき}→陰気：08674_inki⟧ "gloomy" + ⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧ "character"). The term emerged in Japanese internet culture in the 2010s.

REGISTER: Casual/Slang
Primarily used among young people in casual conversation and online. Can be self-deprecating or mildly negative depending on context. Avoid in formal settings.

USAGE NOTES:
・Often used for self-description by introverts
・Can carry negative connotations when used about others
・The opposite term is ⟦{陽|よう}キャ→陽キャ：06442_youkya⟧ (extrovert)
・Sometimes written as インキャ in katakana

CONTRAST:
・{陰|いん}キャ: slang for introvert, casual/youth language
・⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧: introverted (formal, neutral)
・⟦{人見知|ひとみし}り→人見知り：06622_hitomishiri⟧: shy around strangers (specific trait)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {陰|いん}キャ/⟦{陽|よう}キャ→陽キャ：06442_youkya⟧ dichotomy has become a common way for Japanese youth to categorize personality types, similar to introvert/extrovert in English but with more casual, sometimes self-deprecating nuance.
